evidence.title: Efferd - Beautiful Shadcn blocks for Busy & Smart devs.

name: Efferd
summary: 231 shadcn/ui blocks for marketing and app UIs — auth, hero, CTA, pricing, dashboard — free set plus one-time Pro.
description: A library of shadcn/ui blocks: sections you install with the shadcn CLI into any React framework, using either Radix or Base UI primitives and your choice of icon set. Categories cover auth, hero, features, CTA, dashboard, app shell, header, footer, pricing, FAQs, integrations, logo cloud, contact, team, testimonials, blogs and 404 pages. Free blocks are available without an account; a one-time Pro plan unlocks the full set with lifetime updates.
contains: 231 registry items measured in the shadcn registry
14 auth blocks, 20 CTA blocks, 14 dashboards, 11 logo clouds, 9 hero sections
blocks for header, footer, pricing, FAQ, contact, team, testimonials and 404 pages
install with the @efferd shadcn CLI namespace or an MCP server
free tier plus one-time Pro plan ($147) with lifetime updates
